field.name: tax_treatment
field.help: Selects the Finance-controlled tax policy for this quotation. Finance, Quotation, Sales, or Accounting Managers may change it; Standard applies configured VAT and retention while CIF removes taxes, so confirm the commercial terms and select the required treatment before adding or issuing lines.

field.name: is_free_of_charge
field.help: Authorized zero-price exception. A Pricing User or quotation/sales manager marks it and records a reason before Issue Offer PDF.

field.name: free_of_charge_reason
field.help: Required reason for the authorized zero-price exception; resolve it before Issue Offer PDF.

field.name: finance_approval_required
field.help: Shows that one or more current commercial exceptions need manager approval before Issue Offer PDF.

field.name: finance_approval_reason
field.placeholder: State the approval or self-approval reason.
field.help: Manager's audit reason. It is mandatory for self-approval and retained with the approval evidence.

button.name: action_approve_finance_requirements
button.help: Quotation or Sales Management approves every current exception. Any later commercial change invalidates the approval.

div.div: Configure accounting-owned taxes and the normal commercial terms. Tax accounts and reporting tags remain on the configured tax records.

field.name: quotation_retention_tax_id
field.help: Sets the Finance-configured negative withholding tax for Standard quotations. Finance or Accounting Managers select it; it deducts the configured retention after VAT and uses its account and report tags, so choose a validated retention tax before using the Standard treatment.
